same_accumulator_distance.note: intervening (independent-of-that-chain) instruction count between consecutive FMLA writes to the same accumulator vreg -- a scheduling-distance metric derived from MIR instruction order, NOT cycle-accurate latency

load_to_use_distance.note: instructions between a vector load and its first use as an FMLA operand (accumulator-in or multiplicand) -- MIR instruction-order distance, not cycle-accurate latency
